## Approve Invoice for Payment

The control the desk exists for: NO path to payment around an open variance. The command re-runs the match from the documents (never trusting the panel's display), flips a failing invoice to 'exception', and only a clean or fully-resolved match reaches 'approved-for-payment' — from where the existing Record Payment / Process Payment flow takes over unchanged (no parallel payment model).

### Example

Natural target: the linked INV N-4471 — refuses while the freight variance is open; approves once it carries a resolution.

### Non-goals

No payment execution. No tolerance overrides per invoice (tolerances are the desk's policy constants, documented in three-way-match.gts).
